CR-4.title: Learner failing between NEWLEADER and UPTODATE leaks its request processors
CR-4.cause: startupWithoutServing leaves the learner server INITIAL and canShutdown() accepts only RUNNING or ERROR, so Follower.shutdown() after a failure before UPTODATE does not stop the started processors.

CR-5.title: Pre-Zab1.0 synchronization never starts the learner server
CR-5.cause: The UPTODATE-only (pre-Zab1.0) path now calls zk.startServing() without the startupWithoutServing() that only the NEWLEADER branch performs.

MC-1.title: NEWLEADER quorum commits a DIFF history that acknowledging learners have only enqueued
MC-1.cause: At NEWLEADER the learner persists currentEpoch and only enqueues the DIFF proposals to the asynchronous SyncRequestProcessor before writing the NEWLEADER ACK that commits the leader's initial history.

MC-2.title: SyncRequestProcessor ACK written before the NEWLEADER ACK is consumed as the NEWLEADER ACK
MC-2.cause: The update starts the learner pipeline (startupWithoutServing) before the learner thread writes the NEWLEADER ACK, so a forced proposal's ACK can be the first packet LearnerHandler reads after NEWLEADER.

MC-3.title: COMMIT received after NEWLEADER for a proposal buffered before it throws NullPointerException
MC-3.cause: The update clears packetsNotCommitted at NEWLEADER while the unchanged sync-loop COMMIT handler dereferences packetsNotCommitted.peekFirst() without a null check.
